text:
ali_support: Heads up — NimbusData trial is getting 429s on /v1/generate and their onboarding flow is blocked. Ticket #INC-4829 https://support.redwood.ai/t/INC-4829

devon_csm: Renewal ping in ~3 weeks, this is a high-risk activation. Can CS take this as a priority passback?

maria_enablement: I can join a troubleshooting call if we can give console access + a temp quota bump.

jamie_se: Quick look at logs — long prompts + continuous requests. They're on hosted redwood-4b-quant, seqs around ~6k tokens. Likely hitting both rate limits and memory pressure. Suggest temp token cap + enable prefix/KV cache on their route.

sre-oncall: sre-oncall: Incident created (INC-4829), severity=P1, assigned to @ops_lead. Logs: 503 x12, 429 x87 in last 10m.

ops_lead: I'm taking this. Devon — can you spin up a 30m sync with Nimbus now? I'm going to apply an emergency burst to their org for 2 hours (4x quota).

devon_csm: Scheduling call now, invite to Nimbus, SE, and enablement. Drafting comms: "We're applying an emergency capacity increase so you can finish onboarding; we'll follow with root cause and timeline."

ali_support: Customer currently stuck on SES webhook validation step once generation returns. If we get burst they can finish onboarding flow immediately.

maria_enablement: Call agenda I'm preparing: 1) confirm ingestion/throughput, 2) share temporary settings we just applied, 3) action items for prompt/usage optimizations.

jamie_se: I'll prepare a canary: enable KV prefix caching for their org route and reduce max_seq to 4096 for generation. Canary to 10% traffic first.

devon_csm: Owners for this passback: @ops_lead (quota bump & infra), @jamie_se (config canary), @maria_enablement (customer call), @ali_support (ticket comms).

ops_lead: Done — applied 4x quota bump and started canary. Will report back in 10m.

ops_lead: Canary update (10m): metrics look good — 429s dropped to 0, p95 latency down ~30%. Rolling canary to 100% now. Leaving follow-up: postmortem + routing policy tweak (tagging PM/OPS).

devon_csm: Customer call confirmed for +20m. I'll push the comms template to the ticket and cc legal for any SLA language.

ali_support: Updated ticket with actions taken and links to this thread. Added note for follow-up email to Nimbus ops. :white_check_mark:

maria_enablement: I'll capture the enablement play (what we told the customer + how to keep usage below burst thresholds) and update the onboarding checklist.

jamie_se: Follow-ups from SE: open PR with config diff (enable cache, reduce max_seq), also add quantization recommendation (int8) and prompt rewrite suggestions.

devon_csm: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after postmortem to close the loop with the customer. :pray:
